service.description: OPC UA (brokerUri or DeviceConnection.transportConfig opc.tcp://, or driverEnumId DcdOpcUa). DrtRead and DrtWrite on the node ids in DeviceRequestItem.query; DrtSubscribe and DrtEvent create monitored items; DrtCyclic polls at pollingInterval; values are stored through InboundServices.store#Samples. Set as DeviceRequest.runServiceName; called by moqui.device.DeviceServices.run#DeviceRequest. A request whose endpoint is another protocol is an error.
